name: Glasses Alert
summary: Know when someone near you wears Meta smart glasses or carries a Bluetooth camera. Your phone scans Bluetooth, rings a loud alarm through silent mode, and points an arrow towards them. Nothing leaves the phone.

screenshots.alt: Glasses Alert on a phone, watching for smart glasses, with Ray-Ban Meta glasses found close by and the alarm ringing

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: With your permission, listen to Bluetooth adverts nearby; it never connects or pairs
Ring at full alarm volume and vibrate, even on silent, when glasses or a camera are found
On Android, if you allow it, ring through Do Not Disturb and then restore it
Show the alarm and a Stop button as a notification
